summary: v70 Partner Profile Cards + partner join/password/unified login. Backend: new test_v70_partner_profile_cards.py 16/16 PASS (GET/PUT public-profile w/ CSRF + bio<=280, photo upload jpeg/png/webp only -> 422, >2MB -> 413, own photo GET, non-approved partner 403, unauth 401, public photo 404 unless show && !hidden, highlights: name+bio+photo_url for opted-in winner even with show_names=false, code only/no bio/photo when not opted-in, admin hide/unhide (admin+CSRF required, 404 bad id), partner re-save cannot clear admin hide, opt-out removes card, join password -> /agents/auth/login). Regression test_v69 14/14 PASS. UI: /login Partner role -> /partner/me; Leaderboard tab profile card upload (preview renders), bio, show toggle, save persists after reload, 413 toast for big file; homepage home-badge-photo-PT-0001 + home-badge-bio-PT-0001 shown with name; admin /admin/e/partners detail admin-agent-public-profile + admin-agent-hide-profile hides (homepage photo/bio gone) and restores; /partner/join/:token password+confirm, mismatch toast, join -> /partner/me, sign out, re-login via /login partner role -> /partner/me, wrong pw -> 401 toast. One minor UI race found (state reset shortly after first paint).

minor.issue: Type check trusts client-declared content_type only (no magic-byte sniff); file read fully into memory before size check. Served with nosniff so low risk.

Serves photo for any approved opted-in partner, not just current badge winners (partner codes are sequential PT-0001.. so enumerable). Acceptable since partner opted in, but consider restricting to winners.

ui_bugs.issue: Component state is reset ~250ms after first paint (likely parent remount/re-suspense on app bootstrap). Reproduced: clicking signin-role-partner immediately after render shows 'on' then reverts to Supplier, so login goes to supplier endpoint; on join page, passwords typed immediately were cleared ('Please fill out this field'). Works fine after ~1s. SignInE itself has no effects, so the remount is from a parent (auth/i18n bootstrap or lazy route).

issues: Email/password/Continue/register block becomes wider (~1393px right edge) than role cards (~1355px) — subheading 'New partner? Apply to become a PMC partner' widens the form; misaligned.
Monthly statement uses native <input type=month> picker rather than the design-system picker (pre-existing).
Photo file input not reset after a failed (413) upload — still shows the rejected filename.
admin-agent-public-profile only renders when public_profile.show is true, so if admin hid a card and partner later opts out, admin cannot see/clear the hidden flag (minor).

action_items: Investigate the post-first-paint remount that resets SignInE role / AgentJoin password state (find parent that re-keys or re-suspends routes on bootstrap).
Optional: align form width on /login when Partner role selected.
Optional: validate photo magic bytes; reset file input after failed upload; show admin hide control whenever public_profile exists.
critical_code_review_comments: public_highlights correctly gates name/bio/photo via a Mongo filter (show=True, hidden!=True); save_public_profile spreads existing public_profile so partner cannot clear admin 'hidden' — verified.
upload_public_photo: check content_type before await file.read() and cap read size to avoid buffering large bodies.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all flows work; minor load-time state reset race)

rca of the issue: State reset: SignInE has no useEffect touching role, so the reset is a remount from an ancestor shortly after initial render. Repro: open /login, immediately click Partner, poll class of signin-role-partner -> 'pmc-radio on' then 'pmc-radio ' after 250ms.
